questions.stem: What is the name of the point where the three medians of a triangle meet?
questions.solution: The point where the three medians of a triangle meet is called the centroid. This is because the centroid is the intersection point of the medians, which are the lines drawn from each vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side. The other options refer to different points: the orthocentre is where the altitudes meet, the incentre is where the angle bisectors meet, and the circumcentre is where the perpendicular bisectors meet.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about the altitudes of a triangle?
choices: They are always inside the triangle
They are always outside the triangle
They are parallel to each other
questions.solution: The altitudes of a triangle are concurrent, meaning they all intersect at a single point called the orthocenter. This is always true regardless of the triangle's type. Altitudes can be inside, outside, or on the triangle, depending on whether it is acute, obtuse, or right-angled. They are not parallel because they intersect at the orthocenter.

questions.stem: In a triangle, what is the ratio in which the centroid divides each median?
questions.solution: The centroid of a triangle divides each median in the ratio 2:1, with the longer segment being closer to the vertex. This is a fundamental geometric property of centroids, which are the intersection points of the medians. The other options do not reflect this established relationship between the centroid and the medians.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज में, केन्द्रक प्रत्येक माध्यिका को किस अनुपात में विभाजित करता है?

questions.stem: In a right-angled triangle, where is the orthocentre located?
choices: At the vertex of the right angle
At the midpoint of the hypotenuse
questions.solution: In a right-angled triangle, the orthocentre is located at the vertex where the right angle is formed because the altitudes of the triangle intersect there. The other options are incorrect because the orthocentre does not lie inside the triangle, outside the triangle, or at the midpoint of the hypotenuse.

questions.stem: In a triangle, the centroid divides a median into two parts such that the part from the vertex to the centroid is 8 units. What is the length of the entire median?
questions.solution: The centroid divides the median in the ratio 2:1, so the part from the vertex to the centroid is two-thirds of the total length. If this part is 8 units, then the total length is 8 ÷ (2/3) = 12 units. The other options do not follow the 2:1 ratio correctly.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज में, केन्द्रक एक माध्यिका को दो भागों में विभाजित करता है जिसमें शीर्ष से केन्द्रक तक का भाग 8 इकाई है। पूरी माध्यिका की लंबाई क्या है?
hi.solution: केन्द्रक माध्यिका को 2:1 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है, अतः शीर्ष से केन्द्रक तक का भाग कुल लंबाई के दो तिहाई होता है। यदि इस भाग की लंबाई 8 इकाई है, तो कुल लंबाई 8 ÷ (2/3) = 12 इकाई होगी। अन्य विकल्प सही 2:1 अनुपात का अनुसरण नहीं करते।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms like 'केन्द्रक' (centroid) and 'माध्यिका' (median) as used in standard Hindi textbooks.
